data.name: UnknownCommand
data.value: {0} is not a command here. Start the line with // to send it as words.

data.name: Welcome
data.value: Add an IRC server to chat in its channels from Group Chat and with its people from Messages.

data.name: PickServer
data.value: Pick a server on the left.

data.name: PlainWarning
data.value: Without encryption anyone on the way can read everything, and no password is sent (except to this computer).

data.name: NickNote
data.value: If it is taken, the same with _ or a number after it is tried.

data.name: OnConnectNote
data.value: One per line, as a network asks of its users: /msg, /mode and the like.

data.name: ChannelsAreInGroupChat
data.value: Channels are in Group Chat, and conversations with people in Messages.

data.name: ProblemNoEncryption
data.value: Not connected: a password is only sent over an encrypted connection. Turn on TLS for this server.

data.name: ProblemRefused
data.value: Not connected: the server turned the connection away.

data.name: HistoryKept
data.value: This server keeps history: what is said while you are away comes back when you reconnect.

data.name: HistoryNone
data.value: This server keeps no history: what is said while you are not connected is not seen here.

data.name: NotInChannel
data.value: Not in this channel right now.

data.name: NoChannelsListed
data.value: The server listed no channels. Type a channel's name to join it.

data.name: ConfirmBan
data.value: Ban {0} from {2}? This bans {1}, and puts them out.

data.name: NeedNick
data.value: Type a nickname: one word, not starting with # or :.

data.name: NeedPassword
data.value: Type the password for this way of logging in.

data.name: ConfirmDelete
data.value: Remove {0}? Its channels and saved messages go with it.

data.name: ProblemNickname
data.value: Not connected: the server does not accept this nickname. Choose another under Edit.

data.name: CannotRedact
data.value: This server does not let messages be taken back.

data.name: ChannelSettingsNote
data.value: The channel's modes, as this server has them. Changes are sent when you press Save; the lists change as soon as you add or remove a line. The server refuses what your rank does not allow, and says so in Group Chat.

data.name: ChannelSettingsNotRead
data.value: The server has not said yet how this channel is set, so what is ticked may be short of it.

data.name: ModeListBansNote
data.value: Whoever matches one of these cannot join (+b).

data.name: ModeListExceptionsNote
data.value: Whoever matches one of these can join even if a ban matches them too (+e).

data.name: ModeListInvitesNote
data.value: Whoever matches one of these can join an invite-only channel without an invitation (+I).

data.name: ModeKeyTip
data.value: The channel key: only people who give it can join.

data.name: ModeKeyKept
data.value: The channel has a password, which is never shown. Type a new one to change it.

data.name: ModeKeyWillChange
data.value: Saving sets this as the password to join.

data.name: ModeKeyWillGo
data.value: Saving takes the password off: anyone can join.

data.name: ModeKeyNeeded
data.value: Type the password people will need to join.

data.name: ModeKeyNoSpaces
data.value: A channel password cannot have spaces in it.

data.name: ModeNeedsValue
data.value: {0}: give a value, or untick it.

data.name: ModeInviteOnlyTip
data.value: Only people invited, or on the invite exceptions, can join.

data.name: ModeModerated
data.value: Only voiced people and operators speak

data.name: ModeModeratedTip
data.value: Everyone else can read the channel but not send to it.

data.name: ModeNoOutsideTip
data.value: Only people in the channel can send messages to it.

data.name: ModeTopicLockTip
data.value: Others cannot change the channel's topic.

data.name: ModeSecretTip
data.value: The channel does not show in the server's channel list, nor in what is shown about the people in it.

data.name: ModePrivateTip
data.value: An older kind of hidden: the channel may be listed, but outsiders do not see its topic or who is in it.

data.name: ModeRegisteredOnlyTip
data.value: People not logged in to an account on this network cannot join.

data.name: ModeRegisteredSpeakTip
data.value: People not logged in to an account can join and read, but not speak unless given voice.

data.name: ModeNoCtcpTip
data.value: Requests one IRC program sends to everyone's (CTCP) are refused in the channel. /me still works.

data.name: ModeNoColourTip
data.value: Messages with colour or formatting codes are refused.

data.name: ModeLimitTip
data.value: Once this many are in, nobody else can join.

data.name: ModeStripColourTip
data.value: Colour and formatting codes are taken out; the text still goes through.

data.name: ModeRoleplayTip
data.value: Members can speak as a character or narrate a scene (the server's NPC and SCENE commands).

data.name: ModeAuditorium
data.value: Hide the audience from each other

data.name: ModeAuditoriumTip
data.value: Like an auditorium: people without voice see only operators and voiced people in the member list, and not who comes and goes.

data.name: ModeOpModerated
data.value: Messages without voice go to operators only

data.name: ModeOpModeratedTip
data.value: What people without voice send is shown to the channel's operators only, who can pass it on; everyone else sees only operators and voiced people.

data.name: ModeFreeInvite
data.value: Anyone in the channel can invite

data.name: ModeFreeInviteTip
data.value: Members without operator rank may invite people too.

data.name: ModeTlsOnlyTip
data.value: Only people connected to the server with TLS can join.

data.name: ModeNoNoticeTip
data.value: NOTICE messages sent to the whole channel are refused.

data.name: ModeFreeTarget
data.value: Other channels may send people here

data.name: ModeFreeTargetTip
data.value: Any channel may forward people who cannot join it to this one, not only channels run by this channel's operators.

data.name: ModeNoForward
data.value: Refuse people sent on from elsewhere

data.name: ModeNoForwardTip
data.value: People forwarded here by another channel are not let in.

data.name: ModeLargeListsTip
data.value: Set by the network's operators: the channel's ban and exception lists may hold more entries.

data.name: ModePermanentTip
data.value: Set by the network's operators: the channel and its settings stay even when everyone leaves.

data.name: ModeOpersOnlyTip
data.value: Set by the network's operators: only they can join.

data.name: ModeDelayJoinTip
data.value: Someone who joins is not shown in the member list until they first say something.

data.name: ModeNoNickChangeTip
data.value: People in the channel cannot change their nickname while in it.

data.name: ModeNoKickTip
data.value: Channel operators cannot kick people out; only the network's own operators or services can.

data.name: ModeNoKnock
data.value: No asking to be let in

data.name: ModeNoKnockTip
data.value: People outside cannot knock (KNOCK) to ask an operator to let them in.

data.name: ModeNoInviteTip
data.value: Nobody can invite people to the channel.

data.name: ModeBlockCapsTip
data.value: Messages written mostly in capital letters are refused.

data.name: ModeCensorTip
data.value: Words on the server's list are blocked or replaced.

data.name: ModeRegisteredChannelTip
data.value: Set by the network's services: the channel is registered to an owner, who keeps it.

data.name: ModeAllTlsTip
data.value: Set by the server: every person in the channel is connected with TLS.

data.name: ModeForward
data.value: Send those who cannot join to

data.name: ModeForwardTip
data.value: When someone cannot join (full, invite only, banned and so on), the server sends them to this channel instead.

data.name: ModeOverflowTip
data.value: Once the most people allowed are in, newcomers are sent to this channel instead.

data.name: ModeJoinThrottleTip
data.value: Once this many people join within the seconds given, more joins are refused for a while (against join floods).

data.name: ModeFloodTip
data.value: Someone who sends more lines than this within the seconds given is kicked. Put * in front to ban them as well.

data.name: ModeFloodRulesTip
data.value: UnrealIRCd's rules: counts of joins (j), messages (m), nick changes (n) and so on allowed in the seconds after the colon.

data.name: ModeFloodProfileTip
data.value: One of the server's named levels, such as relaxed, normal or strict.

data.name: ModeNickFloodTip
data.value: Once this many nickname changes happen within the seconds given, more are blocked for a while.

data.name: ModeRejoinDelayTip
data.value: Someone kicked cannot come back for this many seconds.

data.name: ModeMessageDelayTip
data.value: Someone who joins cannot speak for this many seconds.

data.name: ModeHistoryTip
data.value: People who join are given up to this many recent lines from within the time given.

data.name: ModeCommand
data.value: Other modes, for those who know IRC

data.name: ModeCommandTip
data.value: Settings this server has that are not named above. Typed as MODE takes them, e.g. +E, -U or +j 5:10, and sent with the rest on Save.

data.name: ModeCommandBad
data.value: Other modes: start with + or - and mode letters, then any values after a space.

data.name: WhoisNoAccount
data.value: Not logged in to an account

data.name: PictureNote
data.value: A web link to a picture. People on this server see it where their IRC program shows pictures.

data.name: PictureUseEveNote
data.value: Your character's portrait from EVE's own image server. It changes when you change it in the game.

data.name: PictureSaved
data.value: Picture saved. It is set again each time this server connects.

data.name: PictureNotKept
data.value: This server does not keep pictures: it is saved here, and set once a server that does is connected.

data.name: PictureLinkBad
data.value: A picture link starts with https:// or http://, has no spaces, and is at most 400 characters.

data.name: StsNote
data.value: The server asked to be reached only encrypted, so it is: port {0}, until {1}.

data.name: StsEditNote
data.value: This server has asked to be reached only encrypted until {1}, so it will be, on port {0}, whatever is set here.

data.name: FileNoHost
data.value: This server does not take files.

data.name: FileHostUnencrypted
data.value: The server's file host is not encrypted, so nothing is sent to it.

data.name: FileNoLink
data.value: The file host took the file but did not say where it is kept.

data.name: FileTypeNotTaken
data.value: The server's file host only takes: {0}.

data.name: FileTypeRefused
data.value: The server's file host does not take this kind of file.

data.name: FileTooBigForHost
data.value: The file is too big for the server's file host.

data.name: FileNotAllowed
data.value: The server's file host refused: log in to an account (SASL) to send files.

data.name: FileCutOff
data.value: The server's file host stopped taking the file part-way. It may be too big for it.
